players.product: Mid- and large-size ultracapacitor (UC) cells and modules (wind pitch control, UPS, AGV), with AI data-center power-stabilization UC in development

quarterly_data.signal: FY2025 (amended annual report, consolidated): revenue KRW 153,582,399,002 (FY2024 KRW 142,075,605,799); operating loss KRW 141,609,582 (FY2024 operating profit KRW 6,197,093,266); net loss KRW 1,007,100,491. Management (MD&A): revenue of KRW 1,536 hundred million came on solid growth in aluminum; the operating loss of KRW 1 hundred million reflected higher fixed costs after the new EV aluminum-parts plant was completed and lower sales of high-value UC products. UC segment revenue KRW 29,148 million with an operating loss of KRW 4,939 million (FY2024 loss KRW 1,925 million).
quarterly_data.figure: FY2025 revenue KRW 153,582,399,002; UC segment revenue KRW 29,148 million

quarterly_data.signal: AI data-center business (annual report, new business): LS Materials plans to supply ultracapacitors for AI data-center power stabilization - AI data centers alternate training and data loading every few seconds, creating large, volatile power swings, and the company says global big-tech companies are reviewing UC as the most suitable solution. In September 2024 it signed an MOU with Vertiv for the AI data-center power-solution business and is reviewing applying its UC in Vertiv's products; it is also proposing its UC to Korean and overseas companies investing in AI data centers, and it developed an AIDC 3.0V 600F low-resistance, low-heat cell.

Grid-stabilization business: LS Materials completed product development for renewable-energy grid stabilization in April 2024; it is discussing UC supply most actively with a global power-equipment company ('S') targeting Germany, completed that company's process audit in November 2024, and plans to pursue contracts and orders for full-scale supply in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: process audit completed November 2024; contracts targeted in 2026

quarterly_data.signal: UC production (FY2025, units): mid-size cells capacity 6,300,000, output 3,109,421, utilization 49.36% (2024: 44.20%); large cells capacity 1,404,000, output 371,430, utilization 26.46% (2024: 40.07%). UC revenue by product (KRW million): mid-size cells 9,862, large cells 7,716, mid-size modules 2,895, large modules 7,729; UC exports KRW 25,656 million of KRW 29,148 million; largest UC customers A 17% and B 10% (not named).

Aluminum and new businesses (annual report): subsidiary LS Alsco's aluminum business had revenue of KRW 104,153 million and operating profit of KRW 7,500 million; HAIMK, a joint venture with Austria's Hammerer Aluminium Industries (HAI) for EV aluminum parts, completed its Gumi plant in May 2025 and is selling to secure mass-production customers (operating loss KRW 4,452 million in 2025). In March 2026 the company added rare-earth materials including permanent magnets and robot / AI-related materials, parts and systems to its business purposes (both at the feasibility-review stage).
quarterly_data.figure: LS Alsco aluminum revenue KRW 104,153 million
